en.通过 Git、解压或手动复制把完整 Skill 目录加入项目，然后重新扫描。设置: Add a complete Skill directory using Git, extraction or copying, then rescan. Settings manage loading policies for discovered Skills; they do not author Skills.
en.消息渠道状态读取失败: Failed to read messaging channel status
en.尚未添加消息平台，可在 CC Connect 管理后台配置。: No messaging platforms added yet. Configure them in the CC Connect console.
en.远程浏览器只读；消息渠道只能在 Harness 本机配置。: Remote browsers are read-only. Configure messaging channels on the Harness host.
en.把 OpenQuantum 接入飞书、钉钉、企业微信、Slack、Telegra: Connect OpenQuantum to Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, Slack, Telegram, Discord, QQ, WeChat and other messaging platforms.
en.本地配置：{p0}。平台 Token 由 CC Connect 保存，不进入源码: Local configuration: {p0}. CC Connect stores platform tokens outside source code, Harness sessions and Git.
en.ZX 重写、Clifford+T 门数比较与完整酉矩阵对照。: ZX rewriting, Clifford+T gate counts and full unitary matrix comparison.
en.电路到 MBQC 模式、资源图、自适应测量和纠正输出。: Convert circuits to MBQC patterns, resource graphs, adaptive measurements and corrected outputs.
en.指定 Pauli 对称性扇区的降比特与同扇区保谱检查。: Taper qubits in a specified Pauli symmetry sector and check spectrum preservation within that sector.
en.Pauli 生成元的 Lie 闭包、分类维数与独立矩阵参照。: Lie closure of Pauli generators, classification dimensions and independent matrix references.
en.驱动耗散单量子位、参数批量扫描和人口梯度，含独立数值对照。: Driven dissipative qubits, parameter sweeps and population gradients, with independent numerical comparisons.
en.Clifford+T 电路带噪采样与可选密度矩阵参照。: Noisy Clifford+T circuit sampling with an optional density matrix reference.
en.Ohmic spin-boson 模型的有限记忆 TEMPO 演化及状态数值检查: Finite-memory TEMPO evolution of an Ohmic spin-boson model, with numerical state checks.
en.矩形 rotated planar-code 构建、ToyNoise、Stim: Rectangular rotated planar codes, ToyNoise, Stim sampling and MWPM decoding.
en.ZNE、REM、PEC、CDR 本地噪声实验，比较相同采样预算下的误差、方差与成: Local noisy ZNE, REM, PEC and CDR experiments comparing error, variance and cost at the same sampling budget.
en.分子活性空间的采样子空间对角化，支持测量频数与可选 FCI 参照。: Sample-based diagonalization in molecular active spaces, with measurement counts and an optional FCI reference.
en.开放 Ising 链的张量跳跃轨迹、统计分析与可选 Lindblad 参照。: Tensor jump trajectories for open Ising chains, statistical analysis and an optional Lindblad reference.
en.二元校验矩阵的 BP+LSD 解码，独立复核 syndrome 一致性。: BP+LSD decoding of binary parity-check matrices, with independent syndrome consistency checks.
en.调用论文的 flow 训练算法，以无矩阵 Pauli 计算学习低能量参数。: Use the paper's flow training algorithm and matrix-free Pauli calculations to learn low-energy parameters.
en.自旋链 DMRG 基态、磁化与纠缠熵计算，可选精确对角化参照。: DMRG ground states, magnetization and entanglement entropy in spin chains, with optional exact diagonalization.
en.由局部 Haar 随机测量估计小系统子区纯度，并与解析值比较。: Estimate subsystem purity from local Haar random measurements and compare with analytic values.
en.统一发现夸父、天衍、国盾、腾讯、本源、FieldQuantum 与逻辑比特后端；: Discover Quafu, Tianyan, Guodun, Tencent, OriginQ, FieldQuantum and LogicalQubit backends. Currently limited to read-only configuration checks and hardware discovery.
en.使用固定 toqito 本地计算密度矩阵、部分转置与 negativity 事实: Pinned toqito computes density matrices, partial transposes and negativity locally. An independent OpenQuantum Validator recomputes key invariants. No cloud or real hardware connection.
en.使用固定 MQT QCEC 在本地判断两份unitary OpenQASM 2: Pinned MQT QCEC checks strict equivalence, equivalence up to phase, non-equivalence or an inconclusive result for two unitary OpenQASM 2 circuits locally. No cloud or real hardware connection.
en.使用固定 Stim 与 PyMatching 在本地运行带 seed 的旋转表面: Pinned Stim and PyMatching run seeded rotated surface-code X/Z memory experiments locally. Reports logical error rates and uncertainty from finite shots. No cloud or hardware access, and no threshold claim from a single point.
en.本地电路、超导与原子阵列约束、transmon 泄漏和里德堡动力学实验；返回数据: Local circuits, superconducting and atomic-array constraints, transmon leakage and Rydberg dynamics. Returns data, charts and explicit units. Prepares a pinned Python environment on first use.
en.本地电路与噪声仿真；首次调用会由 uv 准备固定的 TyxonQ Python: Local circuit and noise simulation. On first use, uv prepares a pinned TyxonQ Python environment. No cloud or real quantum hardware connection.
en.把命名二值目标和线性等式约束编译为 QUBO，以全量枚举复核编译和 penalt: Compile named binary objectives and linear equality constraints into QUBO. Check compilation and penalties by exhaustive enumeration, then solve locally with OriginQ pyqpanda_alg. No quantum cloud or hardware connection.
en.Qiskit 官方电路创建、分析、转译以及 QASM/QPY 序列化工具。: Official Qiskit tools for circuit creation, analysis, transpilation and QASM/QPY serialization.
en.Qiskit 官方文档搜索、页面读取与 IBM Quantum 错误码查询。: Search official Qiskit documentation, read pages and look up IBM Quantum error codes.
en.通过 Qiskit IBM Runtime 查询后端并向 IBM Quantum: Query backends and submit quantum jobs to IBM Quantum using Qiskit IBM Runtime.
en.使用 IBM Quantum AI Transpiler 完成电路路由与综合优化: Circuit routing and synthesis optimization with IBM Quantum AI Transpiler.
en.社区维护的强化学习量子电路综合工具；默认关闭。: Community-maintained reinforcement learning for quantum circuit synthesis. Disabled by default.
en.社区硬件控制面：查询 IBM 与 IonQ 设备，并可提交真实 QPU 任务；启: Community hardware interface: query IBM and IonQ devices and submit real QPU jobs. Review costs and side effects before enabling.
en.本源量子官方运行时：查询悟空 QPU 设备，并可提交采样、期望值与批量任务到本源: Official OriginQ runtime: query Wukong QPU devices and submit sampling, expectation-value and batch jobs to OriginQ Cloud. Sampling and estimation write to real hardware. Review costs and side effects before enabling.
en.供 QPanda3 Runtime MCP 连接本源量子云并向悟空 QPU 提交: QPanda3 Runtime MCP uses this to access OriginQ Cloud and submit Wukong QPU jobs. Separate from ORIGIN_API_TOKEN for FieldQKit read-only discovery. Stored only in the Harness credential store.
en.供 IBM Runtime、IBM Transpiler 与可选硬件 MCP 共: Shared by IBM Runtime, IBM Transpiler and optional hardware MCP. Stored only in the Harness credential store.
en.可选；允许 Quantum Hardware MCP 查询 IonQ 并提交模拟: Optional. Allows Quantum Hardware MCP to query IonQ and submit simulator or real hardware jobs.
en.供 FieldQKit 只读发现夸父量子云硬件；后续真实任务仍需单独审批。: For read-only Quafu hardware discovery through FieldQKit. Real jobs require separate approval.
en.供 FieldQKit 只读发现天衍量子云硬件；后续真实任务仍需单独审批。: For read-only Tianyan hardware discovery through FieldQKit. Real jobs require separate approval.
en.供 FieldQKit 只读发现国盾量子云硬件；后续真实任务仍需单独审批。: For read-only Guodun hardware discovery through FieldQKit. Real jobs require separate approval.
en.供 FieldQKit 只读发现腾讯量子云硬件；后续真实任务仍需单独审批。: For read-only Tencent hardware discovery through FieldQKit. Real jobs require separate approval.
en.供 FieldQKit 只读发现本源量子云硬件；部分操作还需要 pyqpanda: For read-only OriginQ hardware discovery through FieldQKit. Some operations also require pyqpanda3.
en.供 FieldQKit 访问 FieldQuantum 云端模拟器。: For access to FieldQuantum cloud simulators through FieldQKit.
en.供 FieldQKit 只读发现逻辑比特量子云硬件；后续真实任务仍需单独审批。: For read-only LogicalQubit hardware discovery through FieldQKit. Real jobs require separate approval.
en.项目 Agent preset 声明的 Harness 原生 MCP 服务。: Native Harness MCP service declared by the project agent preset.
en.供自定义 MCP 使用的 Harness 安全凭据。: Secure Harness credential for a custom MCP connection.
